title: Norm Bounds for Sparse Random Tensors and Spectral Gap of Random Hypergraphs
summary: Friedman and Wigderson (1995) introduced a notion of second eigenvalue for hypergraphs that generalizes the second eigenvalue of the adjacency matrix of a graph. We show that $r$-uniform Erdős-Rényi hypergraphs on $n$ vertices exhibit a spectral gap as soon as their expected number of hyperedges $m$ satisfies $m \gg n^{r/2}$. Prior work identified this scale only up to logarithmic factors; removing these factors is the main technical challenge.
